اقتربوا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَرَبُوا (iqtarabū) /iq.ta.ra.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِقْتَرَبَ (iqtaraba)
# اِقْتَرِبُوا (iqtaribū) /iq.ta.ri.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِقْتَرَبَ (iqtaraba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
